content.text:
I can't compute either mean, because the working directory has none of the IURC order data.

The directory holds only shell and editor config files (`.bashrc`, `.zshrc`, `.vscode` and similar) and an empty `.claude` settings folder. There are no order documents, no case records and no dataset covering the 58 orders from 2021 to 2025. The sandbox only allows reading this directory, so I didn't look for the data elsewhere.

Any dollar figure I gave for base sections 16(h) or 20(a)(2) would be invented. I'm not offering an estimate, because nothing in the directory gives a basis for one.

If you add the orders (PDFs, text or a extracted table) to the working directory, I can filter to cases with a headline penalty above $0, group by base section, and report both means rounded to the nearest dollar.
